The allowance parameter only bounds the per-caller whitelist balance check inside whitelistMint
The recipient parameter is only forwarded from mint to the internal mint routine
The token id parameter is only used in the owner/approval check and burn call
The new owner parameter is only assigned to the _owner state variable
The local token id snapshot is scoped to _mintWithCost and drives the mint and URI of that function
The token id parameter is only used for the freeze duplicate check and _frozenTokenIds update
The token id array only controls the iteration of the batch transfer loop
